description: Get the webhook configuration — its URL, status, and signing secret. Pass agent_id to get an agent-specific webhook, or omit for the project-level default.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to get that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level webhook.

reveal_secret.description: Include the full signing secret in the output. Off by default: tool output is logged and ends up in model context.

name: get_webhook

outputSchema.description: The webhook configuration (secret masked unless reveal_secret=true).

configured.description: False when no webhook is configured.

contextLimit.description: Recent messages included with each event as context.

secret.description: Signing secret for verifying payloads. Masked unless reveal_secret=true.

title: Get Webhook
